szoveg_eredeti:
Perplexity is evolving into a multiplayer workspace.

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Jeff Grimes (@jeffgrimes9); megjelent: 2026-10-29T19:42:37+00:00; link: https://x.com/jeffgrimes9/status/2115892078857355394; média: videó, 41 másodperc]
You can now share a Computer session by asking Computer directly, without opening the share menu.

Tag a coworker with @ or give their name/email, and Computer sends the invite. If a name matches more than one person, it asks which you mean.

Available now to all Computer users.
